_comment: Etsy SEO reference for printify-storefront skill. All rules sourced from Etsy Seller Handbook, eRank best practices, and top-seller analysis.

rules: Front-load the most important keyword in the first 40 characters (Etsy truncates in search results)
Never start with 'Cute' or 'Funny' alone — too generic, zero search differentiation
Include the product type (T-Shirt, Mug, Tote Bag) — buyers search for products, not just themes
Add occasion words (Gift For, Birthday, Christmas, Mother's Day) — high commercial intent
Use pipe | or dash - as separators, never commas
Avoid ALL CAPS — Etsy penalizes it in search ranking
Never repeat the same keyword — each word should earn its place

rules: Use ALL 13 tags — every unused tag is wasted search visibility
Mix broad + long-tail: 4 broad terms, 5 mid-tail, 4 long-tail niche
Multi-word tags are treated as phrases — 'vintage motel shirt' is one tag
Don't repeat words already in your title — tags supplement, not duplicate
Include gift-related tags: 'gift for him', 'gift for her', 'birthday gift'
Include seasonal tags when relevant: 'christmas gift', 'valentines day'
Include material/style tags: 'retro design', 'minimalist art', 'hand drawn'
Include use-case tags: 'laptop sticker', 'water bottle decal', 'planner sticker'
Avoid single generic words: 'cool', 'nice', 'awesome' waste a tag slot

structure: Hook line — emotionally compelling opening that speaks to the buyer's identity
Design story — 2-3 sentences about the aesthetic, inspiration, what makes it unique
Product specs — material, dimensions, print method, care instructions
Sizing info (apparel only) — link to size chart or key measurements
Gift positioning — who this is perfect for, what occasions
Shipping & production — turnaround time, print-on-demand disclosure
CTA — encourage favoriting and following the shop
seo_rules: First 160 characters appear in Google search results — make them count
Naturally include 2-3 primary keywords in the first paragraph
Use bullet points for specs — scannable content converts better
Mention 'print on demand' or 'made to order' for transparency
Include care instructions — reduces returns and improves reviews

t-shirt.sizing_note: Unisex fit — runs true to size. See size chart in images for exact measurements.
specs: 100% combed ring-spun cotton (Bella+Canvas) or heavy cotton (Gildan)
t-shirt.care: Machine wash cold inside-out, tumble dry low. Do not iron directly on print.

hoodie.sizing_note: Unisex fit — slightly oversized for comfort. Size down for a fitted look.
specs: DTG printed for vibrant, lasting color
hoodie.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Do not bleach.

mug.sizing_note: 11oz standard size — 3.8" tall, holds a perfect cup of coffee or tea.
specs: Vibrant sublimation print that won't fade
mug.care: Dishwasher safe (top rack recommended). Microwave safe.

stickers.sizing_note: Available in multiple sizes. Kiss-cut for easy peel-and-stick application.
specs: UV resistant — won't fade in sunlight
stickers.care: Apply to clean, dry surfaces. Indoor/outdoor use.

tote_bag.sizing_note: 15" x 16" — roomy enough for groceries, books, or daily essentials.
specs: Vibrant DTG print on one or both sides
tote_bag.care: Machine wash cold, hang dry or tumble dry low.

poster.sizing_note: Available in multiple sizes. Printed on premium matte paper.
specs: Unframed — ready for your favorite frame
poster.care: Frame behind glass for best longevity. Avoid direct sunlight.
